card.name: The word prescribed after be or usually
card.fires_on: The word "prescribed" right after "may be", "should be" or "than usually" in label text. It responds to the passive verb, not to the drug names that follow.

modes.description: "Prescribed" follows "may be" or "should be", often before a drug class such as opioids.
